verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a published OpenAPI description (openapi.json) and static REST API endpoint reference pages with versioned paths. Nothing documents an interactive explorer, try-it console, or runnable examples in the API reference. A machine-readable spec and static reference pages are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
